summary_en: 3.3 million shares (3.6% of shares outstanding), ¥5.0 billion upper limit, open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange, June 8 – December 31, 2026. Executed under Articles 156/165 of the Companies Act; aims to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency as part of the medium-term management plan announced May 13, 2025.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: SHIP Healthcare Holdings announced a share buyback authorization on June 5, 2026. The board resolved to acquire up to 3.3 million ordinary shares (3.6% of outstanding shares, excluding treasury stock) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥5.0 billion through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from June 8 through December 31, 2026. The buyback is positioned as part of the company's capital allocation strategy disclosed in its May 13, 2025 medium-term management plan, with the stated objectives of enhancing shareholder returns and improving capital efficiency. The company notes its continued focus on balancing growth investment with shareholder returns while pursuing sustainable improvement in corporate value.
